Short title and commencement

ACT V OF 1974
ACT V OF 1974
FINANCE (SUPPLEMENTARY) ACT, 1973
1. Short title, extent and commencement.---(I) This Act may be
called the Finance (Supplementary) Act, 1973.
(2) It extends to the whole of Pakistan.
(3) It shall come Into force at once.

Flood relief surcharge on customs-duty

ACT V OF 1974
ACT V OF 1974
FINANCE (SUPPLEMENTARY) ACT, 1973
2. Flood relief surcharge on customs-duty.--There shall be levied
ant! collected an additional customs-duty as flood relief surcharge on the
goods specified in the First Schedule to this Act at the rate of 25% of the
customs duty for the time being payable thereon, if any.
